releaseNotes:
### Ticketek

#### Fixes and improvements

- Fixed Focus mode leaving quantity at 0 after restoring Best Available (Any price).
- Changing price ranges no longer trigger recovery solely because the saved price differs.
- Restores the saved quantity once the ticket controls are ready.
- Keeps explicit maximum-price limits and specific-category price protection.
- Adds clearer activity logs for price changes, quantity restoration and validation failures.
- Shows “Any price (live range)” instead of a misleading fixed price.

Stop and held-ticket/checkout protections remain unchanged. No AXS or Ticketmaster changes in this version.

Verification: 92 unit tests and targeted browser fixtures passed. Live Ticketek and native Firefox verification remain manual.
